title: Enforce live trade document permissions and customer scope at every business entry
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Implement live enabled identity and existing doc-center authorization plus current customer scope for list/count/detail/create/update/delete/atomic batch-delete and every item read/write/print/export HTTP entry. CustomerId is authoritative; restricted missing customer fails closed and authorized unrestricted historical behavior remains. Verify new customer against live scope on writes and recheck existing ownership. No ownership inference from free text, no new grants or protected seed/schema modifications. Preserve shared source generation existing authorization and ensure generated target belongs to authorized customer; no leaks through count/export/item/print or exception content.

Use complete controller overrides and reusable Application authorization rules, preserving existing item computation/status freezes and audit. Mixed allowed/foreign batch must fail without partial delete. Real SQL authorized own/unrestricted, foreign/missing-customer/revoked-menu/disabled-user, all custom routes, forged create/update and batch rollback; relevant unit existing item/print/generation regressions and safe Release. Browser evidence or accurate blocker; source generation cannot bypass target authorization.
